title: Required statement.
officialText:
The registration shall clearly state: “This registration is NOT A LICENSE, and the holder is NOT
AUTHORIZED TO PERFORM FIRE SUPPRESSION PIPING WORK in New York city except under the direct and continuing
supervision of a Licensed Master Fire Suppression Piping Contractor.”
ARTICLE 412
OIL-BURNING EQUIPMENT INSTALLER LICENSE
